name: JELI (Jellyfin Enhanced Library Images)
description: JELI generates beautiful perspective thumbnail splash screens for your library content, built directly from each library's own posters, thumbs, and backdrops. Choose from 6 perspective modes (diagonal, floor, ceiling, barrel, flat), add custom overlay images and text layers, upload custom fonts, and schedule automatic regeneration. Built by Synthmania.
overview: Generate perspective thumbnail splash screens for your library content from each of your media libraries.

versions.changelog: Added 8 new bundled default fonts: Disney Script, Cathode, Vin Mono Pro Medium, Neon Light, CassandraTwo, Budmo Jigglish, Budmo Jiggler, CarnavaleDelight (alongside Pasajero and Candy Kisses, now 10 total). Basic settings redesigned: dropdowns on the left, larger perspective preview on the right. New high-resolution (960x540) perspective preview images rendered from the actual algorithm for all 6 modes. Fixed font preload spam (no more 404s for system fonts). Sidebar menu renamed to JELI with custom logo support via /Jeli/Logo endpoint.

Public release. Six perspective modes (↖ Diagonal, ↗ Diagonal, ⬆ Floor, ⬇ Ceiling, ⊙ Barrel, ▦ Flat Wall). Six image source modes. Per-library overlay images and text layers. Two bundled fonts (Pasajero, Candy Kisses). Four default gradient overlays. Auto-scheduling with live task updates. Generations manager tab. Resolution-aware live preview. Output console relocated below the preview panel.
